description: shipmill: refuse the writes the delivery rules forbid

hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/delivery.py"; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then w='uv is not on PATH'; elif [ ! -f "$d" ]; then w="no file $d"; elif ! { p=$(uv python find --no-project '>=3.11' 2>/dev/null </dev/null) && [ -x "$p" ]; } && ! { p=$(uv python install '>=3.11' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null && uv python find --no-project '>=3.11' 2>/dev/null </dev/null) && [ -x "$p" ]; }; then w='uv can find or install no Python 3.11 or newer'; else exec "$p" "$d" pre; fi; echo "shipmill hook: can't start hooks/delivery.py ($w); this command runs unchecked, see shipmill doctor" >&2; exit 1

d="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/delivery.py"; if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then w='uv is not on PATH'; elif [ ! -f "$d" ]; then w="no file $d"; elif ! { p=$(uv python find --no-project '>=3.11' 2>/dev/null </dev/null) && [ -x "$p" ]; } && ! { p=$(uv python install '>=3.11' >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null && uv python find --no-project '>=3.11' 2>/dev/null </dev/null) && [ -x "$p" ]; }; then w='uv can find or install no Python 3.11 or newer'; else exec "$p" "$d" post; fi; echo "shipmill hook: can't start hooks/delivery.py ($w); this command runs unchecked, see shipmill doctor" >&2; exit 1
